content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a project I'd like to implement using a [product_name] [article_no] CPU, digital and analog expansion modules, an INSYS modem, and a [company_name] 24 VDC power supply for the analog expansion module. I also plan to use [product_name] monitor software. The project involves monitoring an 80,000 litre tank, where liquid levels are measured in litres via an ultrasonic level transmitter with a 4-20 mA output. The liquid is then pumped from the tank through a flowmeter into a truck, with a total of ten trucks. I need to log tank level, total flow, and truck numbers, sending this data via email to a specific address twice daily. Will the [product_name] and the components mentioned support this functionality?

Hi [user_name], I think this setup should work! Here's my suggestion: • Use [product_name] Runtime as the HMI to communicate with the [product_name] device and configure the necessary tags (reference: [url]). • Within your [product_name] program, create a data log and link your tags to it. • Write a script in [product_name] to read from that data log. Acquire an SMTP email address (even Gmail can work; see the attached screenshot) and utilize the 'SendEMail' function to transmit the data, such as: [code]SendEMail "designated_email_adress@email.com", "Subject", "Tag or data from the log", "return_email@email.com"[/code] • Set up a scheduler in [product_name] to run the script at your preferred times. Hope this helps!
Thank you, this is very helpful.

No problems or concerns about usability or reliability were mentioned; responses focused on configuration and implementation options.
